wifi: If your footswitch is not connected via Ethernet cable, select same WiFi as the mixer. If it is hidden, input it in the textbox below. In any case, enter the password
wifi-title: Make a WiFi selection to continue
apName: In case you have multiple footswitch (in a band for instance), identify it using appropriate name
currentConfig: Provide a name to this configuration (profile). You can create multiple and switch one one to another
two-tab-title: Clic to move to next module
tour-title: This tour will guide you through the important settings. You can activate or deactivate it at any time. Use the arrows to navigate. Save icon will blink to indicate you have unsaved changes. The top bar allows you to manage multiple profile (load/export/delete/save). Clic assistant next arrow to continue!
layout,0,1: Modules containing strips can be represented by different views.
faderSpeed-title: Test a different value to continue
duration: Reaction time to consider footswitch hold
doubleClic: Defines the interval between two presses. The use of the double click implies temporized presses in order to avoid untimely triggering.
doubleClic-title: Double click can be disabled, slow or fast.
shortcuts: Executes an action at any time, regardless of the context (for example, a shortcut will allow you to load a snapshot while you are in the player module). Very useful to avoid button manipulation.
affectation: Es wird nicht empfohlen, aber wenn Ihnen die Standardkonfiguration nicht zusagt, können Sie die Funktionen neu zuweisen
moduleName1-title: Module names can be changed and enabled or disabled with the ON/OFF switch
modContainer1: Use left and right arrow to navigate in the configurable modules and zoom/unzoom icon to make the strip more legible
Module1-Slot0: A strip represents a track, function, FX, bus or a feature such gain control. They are customizable in each module. A strip has a send, return and a color with an icon that you can setup. Auto color means the color setup on the mixer will be used
Module1-Slot0-title: Clic red cross to delete the strip
slotTPL8: Add a strip to the module
slotTPL8-title: Try by draging and droping a strip from left to right. Clic the red box when done.
ipaddress: Discovery is normally ON and enable the footswitch to automatically find the mixer in the network. You can disable it if you want to force the IP address and port.
file1: Upload file to the footswitch such firmware update, icon, profil, language file...
mychannel: This is a kind of shortcut to be able to define in the strip what is the channel that represents you. Be aware on XAir you can only mute your channel, unless Mute OTHERS is ON
mybus: Shortcut for your monitor to be used in the strips.
macroDropDown: The basic principle of macro is that it records everything that happens on the mixer during a certain period of time to be able to replay it at a later stage using a macro strip. The footswitch will 'observe' the mixer and memorize all actions which are processed from any devices that control it.
macroSpeed: set replay speed which can either be real time  means it will reproduce also the delay you did between two actions recorded in the mixer  or full speed.
macroLoop: Replay can be performed only once or in an infinite loop. It can also be controlled 'manually' by holding down side button to execute step-by-step forward or backward actions.
recordMacro: Start recording the macro selected in the dropdown list
exportMacro: Save a macro as a file that can be shared or imported later on in the SYSTEM tab
progressbar: When recording a macro, show left capacity
wizswitch: Recall the connection wizard at the next footswitch startup
buttonAssignementPanel: It is advised not to change this setting to avoid being unable to use correctly but you can still customize if you like
secondPortHelp: Mixing station HTTP REST port  (8080 default)
mixerIPHelp: Address IP of Behringer mixer or the device running mixing Station
wifiSaved: The credentials have been updated and will be used on the next WiFi connection (if the Ethernet cable is unplugged). Be careful if you unplug the cable now, you will have to reconnect this configuration page.
networkDown: Network Connectivity required: you must establish a connection before using this interface
networkUp: Device is not connected to network
restartUSB: USB is in firmware-update mode. Restart to activate MIDI mode
sysex256: Sequence of sysex hexadecimal bytes (without F0 head and F7 tail) separated by a comma or a space, max. 256
Firmware flash: Do not interrupt firmware download and install
EffectAtNextStartup: Modification will take effect at the next startup.
Reached maximum capacity. Disable other: Reached maximum capacity. Disable other network device(s) to enable this one.
hint.system: Provides internal system settings and firmware services.
hint.directory: Broadcasts the footswitch name on the network and discovers RTP-MIDI endpoints.
hint.directory.scanning: Broadcasts the footswitch name and scans the network for RTP-MIDI endpoints...
hint.webapplication: Hosts the web configuration interface and serves the control application.
hint.usbmidi: Sends and receives MIDI messages over the USB connection.
hint.blemidi: Sends and receives MIDI messages over Bluetooth Low Energy.
hint.dinmidi: Reserved for a physical DIN-MIDI connection; not available on the current hardware.
hint.applemidi: Sends and receives MIDI messages over RTP-MIDI on the network.
hint.sysosc: Sends and receives Open Sound Control messages over UDP.
hint.artnet: Sends DMX data over Art-Net to compatible lighting nodes.
hint.threepindmx: Reserved for the physical 3-pin DMX interface.
clic to select, double clic to rename: click to select, double-click to rename
hint.directory.not_detectable: Device is not detectable on the network. Use {data} to connect
